infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FlexRiders uses the camera to take your daily campaign photos (Morning, Evening and Night).
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FlexRiders may access your photo library only for development testing.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: While you record a campaign route, FlexRiders shares your location with the FlexRiders team so they can see the route you rode.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: While you record a campaign route, FlexRiders keeps sharing your location in the background until you end the route.
